**Comparability note:** Both companies use a December 31 fiscal year end, so FY2023→FY2024 growth is directly comparable on a period basis. The only nomenclature difference is that Meta reports "revenue" while Amazon reports "net sales" — both represent consolidated top-line revenue. Neither figure here is adjusted for divestitures or segment redefinitions.

**Calculation:**

| Company | FY2023 | FY2024 | Growth |
|---|---|---|---|
| Meta Platforms | $134,902M | $164,501M | +21.94% |
| Amazon.com | $574,785M | $637,959M | +10.99% |

- Meta: revenue FY2023 $134,902M → FY2024 $164,501M [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt — Meta Platforms 10-K FY2024, accession 0001326801-25-000017]
- Amazon: net sales FY2023 $574,785M → FY2024 $637,959M [DOC: meta_amzn_growth.txt — Amazon.com 10-K FY2024, accession 0001018724-25-000004]

Meta grew faster, by 21.94% − 10.99% ≈ **10.95 percentage points**. (Note that Meta grows from a much smaller revenue base — roughly one-quarter of Amazon's — so the percentage-point gap overstates the difference in absolute dollar growth: +$29.6B for Meta vs. +$63.2B for Amazon.)

ANSWER: Meta grew faster — 21.9% vs. Amazon's 11.0%, a difference of approximately 10.95 percentage points.
